requirements: Build a To-Do REST API secured with JWT bearer tokens and persisted in DynamoDB. Endpoints: POST /auth/login, POST /todos, GET /todos, GET /todos/{id}, PATCH /todos/{id}, DELETE /todos/{id}. Every mutation must be scoped to the authenticated user. Tokens expire after 1 hour. Validate all inputs. Cover creation, listing, retrieval, update, and deletion flows.
